authorization: Root authorized up to3GiB allocated paired .rmeta relocation only, with verified copy+symlink and no Rust processes
operation: shutil.copy2; source and copied SHA256/size/mode/mtime verification; os.symlink at temporary adjacent path then atomic os.replace over original metadata only
restoration_recipe: Wait until all cargo/rustc/nextest processes have exited.
For each files entry, act only if original is still a symlink to its recorded target; if Cargo has replaced it with a newer regular file, preserve that file and skip the old backup.
Revalidate target SHA256/size/mode/mtime against this report, copy2 target into an adjacent new temporary file under original.parent, and verify the copied SHA256/size/mode/mtime.
Atomically os.replace the verified temporary file over original symlink. Never restore an old metadata file over a newer Cargo output.
After all remaining symlinks are restored or superseded, remove only their recorded tmpfs copies; preserve this report.
limits: Compiler cache only. tmpfs contents are ephemeral; if lost, remove only dangling recorded metadata symlinks so Cargo regenerates them. No rlibs, shared libraries, executables, source, installed packages, or proof artifacts were moved.
